title: Quietly Quarried Dutch Couscous Pilaf
description: A floral and aerated Dutch dish perfect for a date night, featuring couscous and dashi extract, nut-free-friendly. This recipe is designed to be a unique and romantic dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add the couscous to the saucepan, cover, and remove from heat.
Let the couscous steam for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the dashi extract, dried lavender, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked couscous to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the couscous mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
